title: Grateful Dead Live at Alfred State College on 1970-05-01
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard mix captures one of the Dead’s finest acoustic shows with standout New Speedway, Race Is On and Wake Up Little Suzie performances.
ai_review.review: Charlie Miller’s superb soundboard mastering lets you crank this recording loud while preserving every detail of a legendary 1970 acoustic set. The acoustic numbers – especially New Speedway, Race Is On and Wake Up Little Suzie – are tight and energetic, the second‑set jams are “tremendous,” and even the electric portion holds its own.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) praise both the musical performance and the exceptional recording clarity; only a single low‑star comment notes a fade on Lovelight, so the combined show/recording quality merits a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly cite Miller’s remarkable clarity, ability to crank volume, and full instrument separation (e.g., second acoustic guitar on New Speedway). One complaint notes a fade‑out on Lovelight.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set is tight and energetic, second‑set jams are described as tremendous, and the electric portion is solid, giving the concert a balanced and engaging flow.
